Brewalytics - Professional Brewing Analytics

Professional brewing calculations and analytics platform powered by Rust WebAssembly. Calculate SRM color, IBU, gravity, attenuation, and water chemistry with precision using high-performance algorithms.

Features include SRM color calculator, IBU calculator, original gravity calculator, ABV calculator, water chemistry calculator, and attenuation calculator for craft brewers and homebrewers.
